svg.text: Maven Fuzzy Factory – ERD (6 tables) · Snowflake: FUZZY_FACTORY_DB.ECOMMERCE
Central table (sessions = website visits, orders = purchases)
FK row (foreign key) · PK = primary key
dashed = non-identifying (FK not part of PK)
two bars = exactly one · circle = optional · crow’s foot = many
Cardinalities checked on the data: every session has ≥1 pageview, 0 or 1 order; every order has 1–2 items; every item has 0 or 1 refund. user_id has no users table in this dataset.
